_readme: THE SPEAK ALONG LEDGER (PORTRAIT [speak along], 9/30/26). Rule 14 (coordinator 9/14): every face candidate carries his comment back to this chat; each comment becomes the next candidate for that face, quoting his words on the card so he sees his note answered. This file is the proof that happened: one row per non-trivial comment he left on a portrait VOTE item, the id of the LATER portrait item that answers it, and (where the answering item is a real HTML page) the exact phrase from his own words that gates/speak_along_gate.js finds literally present on that page, read off the file on disk, never off the registry's own short why-text (TALK TO HIM LIKE A PERSON deliberately paraphrases that field down to eighth-grade words, so it will never carry his sentence verbatim, and checking it would prove nothing). An answering item that only ever shipped as a flat image has no text surface to check at all; those rows say so plainly rather than faking a pass. A comment answered by the GENERAL uplift of several rounds rather than one exact reply says so honestly in its own note instead of forcing a fake single citation.
